current.title: Deal Wali Dulhan
current.logline: Apni family business bachane ke liye, ek shrewd businesswoman ek anjaan aadmi se contract marriage karti hai. Lekin jab unka farzi rishta asli banne lagta hai, toh Avantika ko Dev ka ek raaz pata chalta hai: woh uski company ko andar se barbaad karne aaya hai.

Avantika Sharma.secret: Her company is on the verge of bankruptcy; the marriage is for a crucial investor.
Avantika Sharma.want: To save her family's legacy and prove her worth.

Dev Mehra.secret: He is the secret CEO of Phoenix Industries, a rival company, sent to acquire/destroy Sharma Textiles out of revenge for his father.
Dev Mehra.want: To acquire Sharma Textiles and fulfill a past grudge.

Rohit Khanna.role: Avantika's jealous ex-fiancé, COO of a rival company
Rohit Khanna.secret: He's unknowingly feeding information about Sharma Textiles to Dev, thinking he's helping a different rival.
Rohit Khanna.want: To see Avantika fail and regain control over her.

arc: Part 1: Apni family business, Sharma Textiles ko bachane ke liye Avantika Sharma ne ek aakhiri deal ki. Ek contract marriage! Uski shaadi ho rahi thi Dev Mehra se, ek charming, simple aadmi, jise sirf 50 lakh rupaye chahiye the. 'Humari deal pakki, Dev,' Avantika ne haath milaya. 'Ek saal ka contract. Tumhe bas mera husband banne ka natak karna hai.' Dev muskuraya. 'Deal.' Lekin kuch ghanton baad, Dev apne luxurious penthouse mein baitha tha, saamne bade TV screen par Sharma Textiles ka logo chamak raha tha. '50 lakh?' usne apne assistant se kaha, 'Main toh puri company lene aaya hoon, Avantika Sharma.' Uski aankhon mein ek thandi chamak thi. Agli subah, unka pehla public appearance hua. Dev ne Avantika ka haath pakda, uski ungliyon ko sehlaate hue. Avantika ko kuch ajeeb laga. 'Ab toh pati patni ban gaye na, Mrs. Sharma?'

Part 2: Avantika ko Dev ke charming andaaz mein kuch ajeeb sa laga. Woh har jagah perfect husband ban raha tha, family aur employees ka dil jeet raha tha. Ek critical investor meeting mein, Avantika apni presentation de rahi thi. Board members aur investor sab uski baat sun rahe the. Tabhi Dev ne 'galti se' uske haath se coffee ka cup chhin liya, aur saari coffee uski presentation par gir gayi. Ek crucial slide bilkul kharab ho gayi. Avantika ka chehra gusse se laal ho gaya, lekin use sabke saamne muskurana pada. 'Oops, sorry, baby!' Dev ne kaha, aankh maarte hue. Investor ne shak se unhe dekha. Baad mein Avantika ne Dev ko phone par baat karte pakda. 'Toh sab set hai, Rohit,' Dev ne dheere se kaha. Avantika ne usse chhip kar suna. Rohit Khanna, uska ex-fiancé! Dev ne jab use dekha, toh turant phone kaat diya. 'Woh Rohit tha,' Dev ne kaha, 'Tumhare baare mein ulta seedha bol raha tha, main usse sambhaal raha tha.' Lekin us raat, Avantika ne Dev ka laptop khola, jo thodi der ke liye unlock reh gaya tha. Usmein ek mail khuli thi: Subject: 'Sharma Textiles Acquisition - Phase 1 Complete,' aur sender ka naam tha 'Phoenix Industries CEO.' Uski saans ruk gayi.

Part 3: Avantika ne jaldi se laptop band kiya, uska dil zoron se dhadak raha tha. Woh jaanti thi Dev ke paas koi raaz hai. Agle kuch din Avantika ne Dev par nazar rakhi. Usne Dev ko 'galti se' uski ek manufacturing problem solve karte dekha. Uski company mein jo machine malfunction kar rahi thi, Dev ne sirf ek nazar mein diagnose kar diya. Avantika hairaan reh gayi. 'Tumhe textiles ke baare mein itna kaise pata hai?' Avantika ne poocha. Dev muskuraya. 'Bas aise hi, thoda research kar leta hoon. Apni biwi ki company hai, after all.' Usne haath badhaya aur Avantika ke haath par apna haath rakh diya, ek halka sa touch. Us raat Avantika ko laga, shayad woh galat soch rahi hai. Lekin phir us raat der raat, Avantika ne paani peene ke liye kitchen mein aayi. Dev ka bedroom door thoda khula tha. Woh phone par baat kar raha tha, dheemi, gusse wali aawaaz mein. 'Deal cancel nahi honi chahiye... Sharma Textiles is mine!' Uske haath se paani ka glass chhoot gaya, aur farsh par bikhar gaya.

Part 4: Glass tootne ki aawaaz sunkar Dev ki aawaaz ruk gayi. Avantika jaldi se wahan se hatt gayi, uska dil zoron se dhadak raha tha. Woh ab aur zyada confused thi. Kuch din baad, ek shareholder meeting mein Rohit ne Avantika ke ek bade project par public mein ungli uthai, usse neecha dikhane ki koshish ki. Tabhi Dev utha, aur poore confidence ke saath Rohit ko counter kiya, uske facts ko galat prove kiya. 'Avantika, tumhare dushmano se toh main hi niptunga,' Dev ne kaha, uska haath Avantika ke haath par tha. Avantika ka dil ek pal ke liye pighal gaya, lekin dimag mein phir woh phone call goonj raha tha. Ussi raat, jab Dev bathroom mein tha, Avantika ne dobara uska laptop khola. Iss baar woh ek hidden folder mein jaane mein kamyaab rahi. Folder ka naam tha 'Operation Phoenix.' Usmein Sharma Textiles ki har kamzori, future project plans, aur ek complete acquisition strategy thi. Har document par 'Phoenix Industries' ka logo tha. Aur usne ek file kholi, jiska title tha 'Phase 3: Final Blow.' Tabhi bathroom se paani band hone ki aawaaz aayi. Dev bahar aa raha tha.

Part 5: Avantika ne ghabra kar laptop band kiya, uska dil itni tezi se dhadak raha tha ki use laga awaz Dev tak jaayegi. Usne jaldi se khud ko sambhala aur normal banne ki koshish ki. Agle din se Avantika ne Dev ke har 'helpful' suggestion ko challenge karna shuru kiya. 'Dev, tumhara yeh idea achha hai, lekin isse humare suppliers ka contract break ho jayega. Tumhe toh business ki samajh hai, yeh kaise miss kiya?' Avantika ne thande lehje mein kaha. Dev ka chehre ka smile pehli baar kam hua. 'Oh, my mistake,' usne dhyaan se Avantika ko dekhte hue kaha. Us raat, Avantika ne apne contacts se Dev ke baare mein research karwai. Jo sach saamne aaya, usne Avantika ke pairon tale zameen khiska di. Dev ka asli naam Dev Singh Rajput tha. Uske father, Virendra Singh Rajput, 15 saal pehle Sharma Textiles mein kaam karte the aur unhe galat tareeke se nikaal diya gaya tha. Uske baad woh depress ho gaye aur unki death ho gayi. Dev apne baap ki maut ka badla lene aaya tha. Avantika ki aankhon mein aansu aa gaye, uske dil ka har tukda toot gaya. Usne Dev ko akela paakar uske saamne ek printout rakh diya. 'Tumhara plan kya hai, Dev?' usne kaanpte hue poocha. 'Sharma Textiles ko barbaad karna?' Dev ne us kagaz ko dekha, usmein 'Phoenix Industries' ka logo chamak raha tha. Uska chehra pathar ka ho gaya. 'Tumne dekh liya na?'

Part 6: Avantika ki aankhon mein aansu the, lekin unmein ab sirf gussa aur badle ki aag thi. 'Toh yeh sab... sirf natak tha?' usne toot-te hue kaha. Dev ki aankhon mein ek pal ke liye regret aaya, 'Nahi Avantika... kuch toh asli tha.' Lekin usne turant khud ko sambhala. 'Haan, main Sharma Textiles ko barbaad karna chahta hoon! Tumhare baap ne mere baap ki zindagi barbaad ki thi! Ab tumhari baari hai!' Agle din Sharma Textiles ki board meeting thi, jismein company ka future decide hone wala tha. Dev, Avantika ke pati ke roop mein, board mein baitha tha. Usne ek proposal rakha, jo Sharma Textiles ko bade financial loss mein daal deta. Lekin Avantika ne use beech mein hi tok diya. Usne uthkar board ke saamne ek naya contract rakha. 'Sorry, Dev Mehra,' Avantika ne kaha, 'Ya Dev Singh Rajput, jo bhi tumhara asli naam hai... tumhare paas ab Sharma Textiles ko barbaad karne ki koi power nahi hai. Kyunki yeh company ab meri nahi... yeh hai 'Sharma-Verma Group' ki.' Usne apna naya acquisition contract board ke saamne rakh diya, jispar ek naye investor ke signature the. Dev ka chehra peela pad gaya. 'Yeh... yeh tumne kaise kiya?' Dev ne kaanpte hue poocha. Avantika ne usse dekha, uske chehre par ab koi emotion nahi tha. 'Jhoothi shaadi ka asli khel, Dev. Tumne shuru kiya tha, aur maine khatam kiya.' Tabhi Dev ke phone par ek notification aaya. Usne dekha: 'Phoenix Industries CEO: Sharma Textiles has just been acquired by... The Verma Group.' Dev ki aankhon mein dard aur shock tha. Uski puri body gusse se kaanp rahi thi.
current.soFar: Avantika Sharma ne apni family business, Sharma Textiles ko bachane ke liye Dev Mehra se contract marriage ki. Dev, jise woh ek seedha-saadha aadmi samajhti thi, asal mein uski company ko barbaad karne aaya hai. Part 2 mein, Avantika ko Dev ke laptop par 'Sharma Textiles Acquisition - Phase 1 Complete' aur 'Phoenix Industries CEO' ki email mili, jisse use Dev ke iraadon par shak hone laga. Part 3 mein, Avantika Dev par nazar rakhti hai. Jab Dev ek complicated machine problem solve karta hai, toh Avantika kuch der ke liye sochti hai ki woh galat hai. Lekin der raat, Avantika Dev ko phone par baat karte pakadti hai, jahan woh gusse mein kehta hai, 'Sharma Textiles is mine!', jisse Avantika ko uske asli iraadon ka poora sach pata chal jaata hai.
current.cliffhanger: Avantika ke haath se paani ka glass chhoot gaya, aur farsh par bikhar gaya. Uska dil itni zor se dhadak raha tha ki use laga Dev ne sun liya hoga.
